72: fn timed_lines(event: &CaldavIcalEvent) -> String {
73:     let start = DateTime::from_timestamp(event.start_utc, 0).unwrap_or(DateTime::UNIX_EPOCH);
74:     let end = DateTime::from_timestamp(event.end_utc, 0).unwrap_or(DateTime::UNIX_EPOCH);
75:     if !event.timezone.trim().is_empty()
76:         && !event.timezone.eq_ignore_ascii_case("utc")
77:         && let Ok(tz) = Tz::from_str(&event.timezone)
78:     {
79:         let start_local = tz.from_utc_datetime(&start.naive_utc());
80:         let end_local = tz.from_utc_datetime(&end.naive_utc());
81:         return format!(
82:             "DTSTART;TZID={}:{}\r\nDTEND;TZID={}:{}\r\n",
83:             event.timezone,
84:             start_local.format("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S"),
85:             event.timezone,
86:             end_local.format("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
87:         );
88:     }
89:     format!(
90:         "DTSTART:{}Z\r\nDTEND:{}Z\r\n",
91:         start.format("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S"),
92:         end.format("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
93:     )
94: }

97:     DateTime::from_timestamp(seconds, 0)
98:         .map(|dt| dt.format("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S").to_string())
99:         .unwrap_or_default()
100: }

102: fn escape_text(text: &str) -> String {
103:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(text.len());
104:     for ch in text.chars() {
105:         match ch {
106:             '\\' => out.push_str("\\\\"),
107:             ';' => out.push_str("\\;"),
108:             ',' => out.push_str("\\,"),
109:             '\n' => out.push_str("\\n"),
110:             '\r' => out.push_str("\\n"),
111:             _ => out.push(ch),
112:         }
113:     }
114:     out
115: }
116: 
117: /// Fold a content line to at most 73 octets per RFC 5545 section 3.1.
118: fn fold_line(line: &str) -> String {
119:     const LIMIT: usize = 73;
120:     if line.len() <= LIMIT {
121:         return format!("{line}\r\n");
122:     }
123:     let chars: Vec<char> = line.chars().collect();
124:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(line.len() + 16);
125:     let mut pos = 0;
126:     let mut first = true;
127:     while pos < chars.len() {
128:         let width = if first { LIMIT } else { LIMIT - 1 };
129:         let mut end = pos;
130:         while end < chars.len() {
131:             let segment: String = chars[pos..=end].iter().collect();
132:             if segment.len() > width {
133:                 break;
134:             }
135:             end += 1;
136:         }
137:         if end == pos {
138:             end = pos + 1;
139:         }
140:         let segment: String = chars[pos..end].iter().collect();
141:         if !first {
142:             out.push(' ');
143:         }
144:         out.push_str(&segment);
145:         out.push_str("\r\n");
146:         pos = end;
147:         first = false;
148:     }
149:     out
150: }

40: impl CaldavAccountService {

42:         &self.pool

50:         Self {
51:             pool,
52:             key,
53:             public_origin,
54:             clock: Arc::new(|| {
55:                 SystemTime::now()
56:                     .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
57:                     .expect("system clock is before Unix epoch")
58:                     .as_secs() as i64
59:             }),
60:         }
61:     }

63:     pub fn new_at(pool: SqlitePool, key: SecretKey, public_origin: Url, now: i64) -> Self {
64:         let mut service = Self::new(pool, key, public_origin);
65:         service.clock = Arc::new(move || now);

69:     pub async fn status(&self, actor_user_id: i64) -> Result<ConnectionStatus, CaldavAuthError> {
70:         let principal_id: Option<String> =
71:             sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT principal_id FROM caldav_accounts WHERE user_id = ?")
72:                 .bind(actor_user_id)
73:                 .fetch_optional(&self.pool)
74:                 .await
75:                 .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
76:         let credentials = self.list_credentials(actor_user_id).await?;
77:         let last_successful_access_at = credentials
78:             .iter()
79:             .filter_map(|credential| credential.last_used_at)
80:             .max();
81:         Ok(ConnectionStatus {
82:             server_url: self.server_url(),
83:             principal_id,
84:             credentials,
85:             last_successful_access_at,
86:         })

89:     pub async fn issue_credential(
90:         &self,
91:         actor_user_id: i64,
92:         label: String,
93:     ) -> Result<IssuedCredential, CaldavAuthError> {
94:         let label = label.trim().to_owned();
95:         if label.is_empty() || label.chars().count() > MAX_LABEL_LENGTH {
96:             return Err(CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials);
97:         }
98:         self.ensure_account(actor_user_id).await?;
99:         let username = self
100:             .user_email(actor_user_id)
101:             .await
102:             .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
103:         let now = (self.clock)();
104:         let password = self.key.generate_token();
105:         let token_prefix = password
106:             .expose()
107:             .chars()
108:             .take(TOKEN_PREFIX_LENGTH)
109:             .collect::<String>();
110:         let token_hash = self
111:             .key
112:             .hash_token(TokenDomain::CaldavConnection, &password);
113:         let mut transaction = self
114:             .pool
115:             .begin()
116:             .await
117:             .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
118:         let id: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(
119:             "INSERT INTO caldav_credentials (
120:                 user_id, label, token_prefix, token_hash, created_at
121:              ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
122:              RETURNING id",
123:         )
124:         .bind(actor_user_id)
125:         .bind(&label)
126:         .bind(&token_prefix)
127:         .bind(token_hash.as_bytes().to_vec())
128:         .bind(now)
129:         .fetch_one(&mut *transaction)
130:         .await
131:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
132:         insert_audit(
133:             &mut transaction,
134:             actor_user_id,
135:             "caldav.credential.issue",
136:             id,
137:             now,
138:         )
139:         .await?;
140:         transaction
141:             .commit()
142:             .await
143:             .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
144:         Ok(IssuedCredential {
145:             metadata: CredentialMetadata {
146:                 id,
147:                 label,
148:                 created_at: now,
149:                 last_used_at: None,
150:             },
151:             username,
152:             password,
153:             server_url: self.server_url(),
154:         })
155:     }

157:     pub async fn revoke_credential(
158:         &self,
159:         actor_user_id: i64,
160:         credential_id: i64,
161:     ) -> Result<(), CaldavAuthError> {
162:         let now = (self.clock)();
163:         let mut transaction = self
164:             .pool
165:             .begin()
166:             .await
167:             .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
168:         let result = sqlx::query(
169:             "UPDATE caldav_credentials
170:                  SET revoked_at = ?
171:               WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ? AND revoked_at IS NULL",
172:         )
173:         .bind(now)
174:         .bind(credential_id)
175:         .bind(actor_user_id)
176:         .execute(&mut *transaction)
177:         .await
178:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
179:         if result.rows_affected() == 0 {
180:             return Err(CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials);
181:         }
182:         insert_audit(
183:             &mut transaction,
184:             actor_user_id,
185:             "caldav.credential.revoke",
186:             credential_id,
187:             now,
188:         )
189:         .await?;
190:         transaction
191:             .commit()
192:             .await
193:             .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
194:         Ok(())
195:     }

229:     pub async fn authenticate(
230:         &self,
231:         authorization: &HeaderValue,
232:     ) -> Result<DavSession, CaldavAuthError> {
233:         let (username, password) =
234:             parse_basic_authorization(authorization).ok_or(CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials)?;
235:         let username = username.to_ascii_lowercase();
236:         let token = SecretToken::parse(&password).ok_or(CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials)?;
237:         let token_prefix = password
238:             .chars()
239:             .take(TOKEN_PREFIX_LENGTH)
240:             .collect::<String>();
241:         let user_id: Option<i64> = sqlx::query_scalar(
242:             "SELECT id FROM users WHERE normalized_email = ? AND status = 'active'",
243:         )
244:         .bind(&username)
245:         .fetch_optional(&self.pool)
246:         .await
247:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
248:         let candidates: Vec<(i64, Vec<u8>)> = match user_id {
249:             Some(user_id) => sqlx::query_as(
250:                 "SELECT id, token_hash FROM caldav_credentials
251:                  WHERE user_id = ? AND token_prefix = ? AND revoked_at IS NULL",
252:             )
253:             .bind(user_id)
254:             .bind(&token_prefix)
255:             .fetch_all(&self.pool)
256:             .await
257:             .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?,
258:             None => Vec::new(),
259:         };
260:         let principal_id: Option<String> = match user_id {
261:             Some(user_id) => {
262:                 sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT principal_id FROM caldav_accounts WHERE user_id = ?")
263:                     .bind(user_id)
264:                     .fetch_optional(&self.pool)
265:                     .await
266:                     .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?
267:             }
268:             None => None,
269:         };
270:         let mut verified: Option<i64> = None;
271:         let mut checked_candidate = false;
272:         for (credential_id, token_hash) in &candidates {
273:             checked_candidate = true;
274:             let expected = crate::security::TokenHash::from_bytes(
275:                 token_hash
276:                     .as_slice()
277:                     .try_into()
278:                     .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?,
279:             );
280:             if self
281:                 .key
282:                 .verify_token(TokenDomain::CaldavConnection, &token, &expected)
283:             {
284:                 verified = Some(*credential_id);
285:                 break;
286:             }
287:         }
288:         if !checked_candidate {
289:             // Verify against a dummy hash so unknown-user, unknown-prefix, and
290:             // wrong-password failures take comparable time and do not reveal
291:             // which lookup failed.
292:             let dummy = crate::security::TokenHash::from_bytes([0_u8; 32]);
293:             let _ = self
294:                 .key
295:                 .verify_token(TokenDomain::CaldavConnection, &token, &dummy);
296:         }
297:         let credential_id = verified.ok_or(CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials)?;
298:         let principal_id = principal_id.ok_or(CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials)?;
299:         let user_id = user_id.ok_or(CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials)?;
300:         let now = (self.clock)();
301:         sqlx::query(
302:             "UPDATE caldav_credentials SET last_used_at = ? WHERE id = ? AND revoked_at IS NULL",
303:         )
304:         .bind(now)
305:         .bind(credential_id)
306:         .execute(&self.pool)
307:         .await
308:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
309:         Ok(DavSession {
310:             user_id,
311:             credential_id,
312:             principal_id,
313:         })
314:     }

502: fn parse_basic_authorization(authorization: &HeaderValue) -> Option<(String, String)> {
503:     let encoded = authorization.to_str().ok()?;
504:     let (scheme, credentials) = encoded.split_once(' ')?;
505:     if !scheme.eq_ignore_ascii_case("basic") {
506:         return None;
507:     }
508:     let decoded = STANDARD.decode(credentials).ok()?;
509:     let string = String::from_utf8(decoded).ok()?;
510:     let (username, password) = string.split_once(':')?;
511:     if username.is_empty() || password.is_empty() {
512:         return None;
513:     }
514:     Some((username.to_owned(), password.to_owned()))
515: }

517: async fn insert_audit(
518:     transaction: &mut sqlx::Transaction<'_, sqlx::Sqlite>,
519:     actor_user_id: i64,
520:     action: &'static str,
521:     credential_id: i64,
522:     now: i64,
523: ) -> Result<(), CaldavAuthError> {
524:     sqlx::query(
525:         "INSERT INTO audit_log (
526:             actor_user_id, action, target_type, target_id, metadata_json, created_at
527:          ) VALUES (?, ?, 'caldav_credential', ?, NULL, ?)",
528:     )
529:     .bind(actor_user_id)
530:     .bind(action)
531:     .bind(credential_id.to_string())
532:     .bind(now)
533:     .execute(&mut **transaction)
534:     .await
535:     .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
536:     Ok(())
537: }

470: fn privileges_for_role(role: &str) -> Vec<&'static str> {
471:     let Ok(role) = CalendarRole::from_str(role) else {
472:         return Vec::new();
473:     };
474:     let allows = |action: CalendarAction| {
475:         authorize_calendar_action(
476:             UserStatus::Active,
477:             Some(PlatformRole::User),
478:             Some(role),
479:             action,
480:         ) == AuthorizationDecision::Allow
481:     };
482:     let mut privileges = vec!["DAV:read-current-user-privilege-set"];
483:     let can_read = allows(CalendarAction::ReadDetails) || allows(CalendarAction::ReadFreeBusy);
484:     if can_read {
485:         privileges.push("DAV:read");
486:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-subscribe");
487:     }
488:     if allows(CalendarAction::ReadFreeBusy) {
489:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-write-freebusy");
490:     }
491:     let writable = allows(CalendarAction::CreateEvent) || allows(CalendarAction::EditAnyEvent);
492:     if writable {
493:         privileges.push("DAV:write-content");
494:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-write");
495:     }
496:     if allows(CalendarAction::ManageSettings) {
497:         privileges.push("DAV:write-properties");
498:     }
499:     if allows(CalendarAction::ManageAcl) {
500:         privileges.push("DAV:read-acl");
501:         privileges.push("DAV:write-acl");
502:     }
503:     if writable && allows(CalendarAction::ManageSettings) {
504:         privileges.push("DAV:write");
505:     }
506:     if allows(CalendarAction::DeleteCalendar) {
507:         privileges.push("DAV:all");
508:     }
509:     privileges
510: }

516:         .collect::<Vec<_>>()
517:         .join("\n");
518:     format!(
519:         "      <D:current-user-privilege-set>\n{entries}\n      </D:current-user-privilege-set>"
520:     )

645: fn ical_and_etag(resource: &CaldavEventResource, event: &Event) -> Option<(String, String)> {
646:     let EventTiming::Timed {
647:         start_utc,
648:         end_utc,
649:         timezone,
650:     } = &event.timing
651:     else {
652:         return None;
653:     };
654:     let ical = serialize_event_resource(&CaldavIcalEvent {
655:         uid: resource.uid.clone(),
656:         summary: event.title.clone(),
657:         description: event.description.clone(),
658:         location: event.location.clone(),
659:         status: Some(
660:             match event.status {
661:                 EventStatus::Tentative => "TENTATIVE",
662:                 EventStatus::Confirmed => "CONFIRMED",
663:                 EventStatus::Cancelled => "CANCELLED",
664:             }
665:             .to_owned(),
666:         ),
667:         start_utc: *start_utc,
668:         end_utc: *end_utc,
669:         timezone: timezone.clone(),
670:         dtstamp: event.created_at,
671:         sequence: event.version as u64,
672:     });
673:     let etag = etag_for_ical(&ical);
674:     Some((ical, etag))
675: }

770: async fn get_apple_connection(

772:     Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
773: ) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {

781: async fn create_apple_password(
782:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
783:     Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
784:     Json(request): Json<CreatePasswordRequest>,
785: ) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
786:     let label = request.label.trim().to_owned();
787:     if label.is_empty() || label.chars().count() > MAX_LABEL_LENGTH {
788:         return Err(ApiError::bad_request());
789:     }
790:     let issued = accounts
791:         .issue_credential(session.user.id, label)
792:         .await
793:         .map_err(map_caldav_error)?;
794:     let response = CreatePasswordResponse {
795:         server_url: issued.server_url,
796:         username: issued.username,
797:         clear_password: issued.password.expose().to_owned(),
798:         password: issued.metadata,
799:     };
800:     Ok((StatusCode::CREATED, Json(response)))
801: }

803: async fn revoke_apple_password(
804:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
805:     Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
806:     Path(credential_id): Path<i64>,
807: ) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
808:     accounts
809:         .revoke_credential(session.user.id, credential_id)
810:         .await
811:         .map_err(|error| match error {
812:             CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials | CaldavAuthError::Revoked => ApiError::not_found(),
813:             other => map_caldav_error(other),
814:         })?;
815:     Ok(StatusCode::NO_CONTENT)
816: }
817: 
818: async fn disconnect_apple(
819:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
820:     Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
821: ) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
822:     accounts
823:         .revoke_all(session.user.id)
824:         .await
825:         .map_err(map_caldav_error)?;
826:     Ok(StatusCode::NO_CONTENT)
827: }

829: fn map_caldav_error(error: CaldavAuthError) -> ApiError {
830:     match error {
831:         CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials | CaldavAuthError::Revoked => ApiError::bad_request(),
832:         CaldavAuthError::RateLimited => ApiError::rate_limited(),
833:         CaldavAuthError::Persistence => ApiError::internal(),
834:     }
835: }

21: /// Serialize one canonical VCALENDAR resource for a single timed event.
22: ///
23: /// The output is deterministic for a given input: property order is fixed,
24: /// text is escaped per RFC 5545, and long lines are folded.
25: pub fn serialize_event_resource(event: &CaldavIcalEvent) -> String {
26:     let mut out = String::new();
27:     out.push_str("BEGIN:VCALENDAR\r\n");
28:     out.push_str("VERSION:2.0\r\n");
29:     out.push_str("PRODID:-//Happening//CalDAV 1.0//EN\r\n");
30:     out.push_str("CALSCALE:GREGORIAN\r\n");
31:     out.push_str("BEGIN:VEVENT\r\n");

33:     out.push_str(&fold_line(&format!(
34:         "DTSTAMP:{}Z",
35:         utc_timestamp(event.dtstamp)
36:     )));
37:     out.push_str(&timed_lines(event));
38:     out.push_str(&fold_line(&format!(
39:         "SUMMARY:{}",
40:         escape_text(&event.summary)
41:     )));

49:         out.push_str(&fold_line(&format!("LOCATION:{}", escape_text(location))));

60: /// Strong ETag derived from the canonical resource content.

62: /// The tag changes exactly when the serialized content changes and never
63: /// reuses a value for different content.
64: pub fn etag_for_ical(content: &str) -> String {
65:     let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
66:     hasher.update(content.as_bytes());
67:     let digest = hasher.finalize();
68:     let hex: String = digest.iter().map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}")).collect();
69:     format!("\"{hex}\"")

72: fn timed_lines(event: &CaldavIcalEvent) -> String {
73:     let start = DateTime::from_timestamp(event.start_utc, 0).unwrap_or(DateTime::UNIX_EPOCH);
74:     let end = DateTime::from_timestamp(event.end_utc, 0).unwrap_or(DateTime::UNIX_EPOCH);

644: /// Canonical iCalendar content and strong ETag for one exposed event.
645: fn ical_and_etag(resource: &CaldavEventResource, event: &Event) -> Option<(String, String)> {
646:     let EventTiming::Timed {
647:         start_utc,
648:         end_utc,
649:         timezone,
650:     } = &event.timing
651:     else {
652:         return None;
653:     };
654:     let ical = serialize_event_resource(&CaldavIcalEvent {
655:         uid: resource.uid.clone(),
656:         summary: event.title.clone(),
657:         description: event.description.clone(),
658:         location: event.location.clone(),
659:         status: Some(
660:             match event.status {
661:                 EventStatus::Tentative => "TENTATIVE",
662:                 EventStatus::Confirmed => "CONFIRMED",
663:                 EventStatus::Cancelled => "CANCELLED",
664:             }
665:             .to_owned(),
666:         ),
667:         start_utc: *start_utc,
668:         end_utc: *end_utc,
669:         timezone: timezone.clone(),
670:         dtstamp: event.created_at,
671:         sequence: event.version as u64,
672:     });
673:     let etag = etag_for_ical(&ical);
674:     Some((ical, etag))
675: }

770: async fn get_apple_connection(
771:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
772:     Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
773: ) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
774:     let status = accounts

781: async fn create_apple_password(
782:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
783:     Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
784:     Json(request): Json<CreatePasswordRequest>,
785: ) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
786:     let label = request.label.trim().to_owned();
787:     if label.is_empty() || label.chars().count() > MAX_LABEL_LENGTH {
788:         return Err(ApiError::bad_request());
789:     }
790:     let issued = accounts
791:         .issue_credential(session.user.id, label)
792:         .await
793:         .map_err(map_caldav_error)?;
794:     let response = CreatePasswordResponse {
795:         server_url: issued.server_url,
796:         username: issued.username,
797:         clear_password: issued.password.expose().to_owned(),
798:         password: issued.metadata,
799:     };
800:     Ok((StatusCode::CREATED, Json(response)))
801: }

803: async fn revoke_apple_password(
804:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
805:     Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
806:     Path(credential_id): Path<i64>,
807: ) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
808:     accounts
809:         .revoke_credential(session.user.id, credential_id)
810:         .await
811:         .map_err(|error| match error {
812:             CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials | CaldavAuthError::Revoked => ApiError::not_found(),
813:             other => map_caldav_error(other),
814:         })?;
815:     Ok(StatusCode::NO_CONTENT)
816: }
817: 
818: async fn disconnect_apple(
819:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
820:     Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
821: ) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
822:     accounts
823:         .revoke_all(session.user.id)
824:         .await
825:         .map_err(map_caldav_error)?;
826:     Ok(StatusCode::NO_CONTENT)
827: }

829: fn map_caldav_error(error: CaldavAuthError) -> ApiError {
830:     match error {
831:         CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials | CaldavAuthError::Revoked => ApiError::bad_request(),
832:         CaldavAuthError::RateLimited => ApiError::rate_limited(),
833:         CaldavAuthError::Persistence => ApiError::internal(),
834:     }
835: }

241:     limits: IcsParserLimits,
242: ) -> Result<NormalizedEvent, IcsParseError> {

246:     }

249:         "DTSTART",
250:         "DTEND",
251:         "DURATION",
252:         "SUMMARY",
253:         "DESCRIPTION",
254:         "LOCATION",
255:         "STATUS",
256:         "RRULE",
257:         "RECURRENCE-ID",
258:         "SEQUENCE",
259:         "DTSTAMP",
260:         "LAST-MODIFIED",
261:     ] {
262:         if fields.get(name).is_some_and(|values| values.len() > 1) {
263:             return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent));
264:         }

266:     let one = |name: &str| fields.get(name).and_then(|v| v.first());
267:     let uid = text(
268:         one("UID").ok_or(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent))?,
269:         limits,
270:     )?;

272:         return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent));
273:     }
274:     let start =
275:         date_value(one("DTSTART").ok_or(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent))?)?;
276:     let end = one("DTEND").map(date_value).transpose()?;
277:     let duration = one("DURATION")

282:     }
283:     let timezone = one("DTSTART").and_then(|p| p.params.get("TZID")).cloned();

287:         return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent));
288:     }
289:     let timing = timing(start, end, duration, timezone)?;
290:     let recurrence_id = one("RECURRENCE-ID").map(date_value).transpose()?;
291:     if recurrence_id
292:         .as_ref()

295:         return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent));
296:     }
297:     let mut exdates = Vec::new();
298:     for p in fields.get("EXDATE").into_iter().flatten() {
299:         for value in p.value.split(',') {
300:             let copied = Property {
301:                 value: value.to_owned(),
302:                 ..p.clone()
303:             };
304:             let value = date_value(&copied)?;
305:             if !same_kind(&value, &timing) {
306:                 return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent));
307:             }
308:             exdates.push(value);
309:             if exdates.len() > limits.max_recurrence_values {
310:                 return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::LimitExceeded));
311:             }
312:         }
313:     }
314:     let rrule = one("RRULE").map(|p| p.value.clone());
315:     if let Some(rule) = &rrule {
316:         if rule.split(';').count() > limits.max_recurrence_values {
317:             return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::LimitExceeded));
318:         }
319:         if RecurrenceRule::parse(rule).is_err() {
320:             return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent));
321:         }
322:     }
323:     let status = one("STATUS").map(|p| p.value.clone());
324:     if status
325:         .as_deref()
326:         .is_some_and(|s| !matches!(s, "CONFIRMED" | "TENTATIVE" | "CANCELLED"))
327:     {
328:         return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent));
329:     }
330:     Ok(NormalizedEvent {
331:         uid,
332:         timing,
333:         summary: one("SUMMARY")
334:             .map(|p| text(p, limits))
335:             .transpose()?
336:             .unwrap_or_default(),
337:         description: one("DESCRIPTION").map(|p| text(p, limits)).transpose()?,
338:         location: one("LOCATION").map(|p| text(p, limits)).transpose()?,
339:         status,
340:         rrule,
341:         exdates,
342:         recurrence_id,
343:         sequence: one("SEQUENCE")
344:             .map(|p| p.value.parse())
345:             .transpose()
346:             .map_err(|_| IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent))?
347:             .unwrap_or(0),
348:         dtstamp: one("DTSTAMP").map(utc_datetime).transpose()?,
349:         last_modified: one("LAST-MODIFIED").map(utc_datetime).transpose()?,
350:     })
351: }
352: fn text(p: &Property, limits: IcsParserLimits) -> Result<String, IcsParseError> {
353:     if p.value.len() > limits.max_text_bytes {
354:         return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::LimitExceeded));
355:     }
356:     let mut out = String::new();
357:     let mut escaped = false;
358:     for c in p.value.chars() {
359:         if escaped {
360:             out.push(match c {
361:                 'n' | 'N' => '\n',
362:                 '\\' => '\\',
363:                 ',' => ',',
364:                 ';' => ';',
365:                 _ => return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::Malformed)),
366:             });
367:             escaped = false;
368:         } else if c == '\\' {
369:             escaped = true;
370:         } else {
371:             out.push(c);
372:         }
373:     }
374:     if escaped || out.len() > limits.max_text_bytes {
375:         return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::LimitExceeded));
376:     }
377:     Ok(out)
378: }
379: fn date_value(p: &Property) -> Result<NormalizedDateValue, IcsParseError> {
380:     if p.params.get("VALUE").is_some_and(|v| v != "DATE") {
381:         return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent));
382:     }
383:     if p.params.get("VALUE").is_some_and(|v| v == "DATE") || p.value.len() == 8 {
384:         return NaiveDate::parse_from_str(&p.value, "%Y%m%d")

386:             .map_err(|_| IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent));
387:     }
388:     let naive = NaiveDateTime::parse_from_str(p.value.trim_end_matches('Z'), "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
389:         .map_err(|_| IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent))?;
390:     let value = if p.value.ends_with('Z') {
391:         naive.and_utc()
392:     } else if let Some(tz) = p.params.get("TZID") {
393:         let tz: Tz = tz
394:             .parse()
395:             .map_err(|_| IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent))?;
396:         match tz.from_local_datetime(&naive) {
397:             LocalResult::Single(v) => v.with_timezone(&Utc),
398:             _ => return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent)),
399:         }
400:     } else {
401:         naive.and_utc()
402:     };
403:     Ok(NormalizedDateValue::Timed(value))
404: }
405: fn timing(
406:     start: NormalizedDateValue,
407:     end: Option<NormalizedDateValue>,
408:     duration: Option<Duration>,
409:     timezone: Option<String>,
410: ) -> Result<NormalizedTiming, IcsParseError> {
411:     match (start, end, duration) {
412:         (NormalizedDateValue::Timed(s), Some(NormalizedDateValue::Timed(e)), None) if e > s => {
413:             Ok(NormalizedTiming::Timed {
414:                 starts_at: s,
415:                 ends_at: e,
416:                 timezone,
417:             })
418:         }
419:         (NormalizedDateValue::Timed(s), None, Some(d)) if d > Duration::zero() => {
420:             Ok(NormalizedTiming::Timed {
421:                 starts_at: s,
422:                 ends_at: s + d,
423:                 timezone,
424:             })
425:         }
426:         (NormalizedDateValue::AllDay(s), Some(NormalizedDateValue::AllDay(e)), None)
427:             if e > s && timezone.is_none() =>
428:         {
429:             Ok(NormalizedTiming::AllDay {
430:                 start_date: s,
431:                 end_date: e,
432:             })
433:         }
434:         (NormalizedDateValue::AllDay(s), None, Some(d))
435:             if d > Duration::zero() && d.num_seconds() % 86_400 == 0 && timezone.is_none() =>
436:         {
437:             Ok(NormalizedTiming::AllDay {
438:                 start_date: s,
439:                 end_date: s
440:                     .checked_add_signed(d)
441:                     .ok_or(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent))?,
442:             })
443:         }
444:         _ => Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent)),
445:     }
446: }
447: fn parse_duration(value: &str) -> Result<Duration, IcsParseError> {
448:     if !value.starts_with('P') || value.contains('-') {
449:         return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent));
450:     }
451:     let mut seconds = 0_i64;
452:     let mut n = String::new();
453:     for ch in value[1..].chars() {
454:         if ch.is_ascii_digit() {
455:             n.push(ch);
456:             continue;
457:         }
458:         if ch == 'T' {
459:             continue;
460:         }
461:         let number: i64 = n
462:             .parse()
463:             .map_err(|_| IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent))?;
464:         n.clear();
465:         seconds = seconds
466:             .checked_add(match ch {
467:                 'W' => number * 604_800,
468:                 'D' => number * 86_400,
469:                 'H' => number * 3_600,
470:                 'M' => number * 60,
471:                 'S' => number,
472:                 _ => return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent)),
473:             })
474:             .ok_or(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent))?;
475:     }
476:     if !n.is_empty() || seconds <= 0 {
477:         return Err(IcsParseError::new(IcsParseErrorCode::InvalidEvent));
478:     }
479:     Ok(Duration::seconds(seconds))
